$about: HeyOz → shadcn/ui. Fills shadcn's CSS variable slots with HeyOz tokens so every shadcn component renders in HeyOz colours, radii and fonts. Every value is a {token} reference; the build checks each one and writes exports/shadcn/globals.css and docs/shadcn.md (D-038). Target: shadcn/ui on Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-first config, OKLCH).
shadcn: shadcn CLI (shadcn@latest init, style base-nova) on Tailwind CSS v4, checked 2026-11-06

card: Cards and panels: the first surface above the background.
popover: Menus, selects, popovers and dialogs float one step above cards (modals use surface/secondary).
primary: shadcn's default button, checkbox, switch, slider and radio. White, like the HeyOz primary button, so orange stays for the one main action (use brand).
primary-foreground: Dark text and icons on primary.
muted: Quiet backgrounds: tabs list, skeletons, code, table rows.
accent: Hover and focus on menu items, ghost and outline buttons: one step above the popover surface.
destructive-foreground: Text on destructive (shadcn maps it in @theme but no longer defines it; HeyOz does).
border: Default borders and dividers: two steps above surface/primary.
input: Input, select and outline button borders.
sidebar-primary: The logo square and brand mark in the sidebar header (the HeyOz logomark is orange).
sidebar-accent: The current page item (sidenav item.active.fill). shadcn also uses it for hover; HeyOz hover is sidebar-accent-hover below.
sidebar-ring: Focus ring in the side nav.

extras.$about: HeyOz colours shadcn has no slot for, added the shadcn way: a colour and its -foreground, mapped in @theme inline so bg-brand, text-brand-foreground and the rest work.
brand: The one main action on a screen (Generate, Export). HeyOz button type brand.
brand-muted: A brand action that should not shout. HeyOz button type brand-tone.

states.$about: shadcn makes hover by fading a colour (bg-primary/90). HeyOz uses real steps: hover one step up, pressed two (D-035). These variables carry those steps; swap the classes listed in swaps.
accent-active: Menu item or ghost button, pressed.
input-hover: Input and outline borders, pointed at.
input-active: Input and outline borders, pressed or open.
sidebar-accent-hover: Side nav item, pointed at (sidenav item.hover.fill).

swaps.$about: Class changes inside the shadcn component files (components/ui/*.tsx). Optional: without them every component works, its hover just fades instead of stepping. Exact classes differ a little between shadcn styles (base-nova, new-york); look for the pattern on the left.

radius.$about: shadcn derives its radii from one --radius with multipliers. HeyOz has a fixed scale with the same names, so each Tailwind radius is set to the HeyOz token of the same name: rounded-md is radius/md (8). --radius is radius/lg (12), what shadcn calls lg.

fonts.$about: font-sans is Geist (body and label); font-heading and font-display are Bricolage Grotesque (display and heading; shadcn's own headings use font-heading). Each reads a next/font variable first and falls back to the installed family name: load Geist with variable --font-geist-sans (the create-next-app default) and Bricolage Grotesque with --font-bricolage.

notMapped.chart-1 … chart-5: HeyOz has no chart palette (D-012). The file keeps shadcn's dark chart colours so charts still render; they are not HeyOz colours. Revisit with the first screen that needs a chart.
notMapped.light mode: HeyOz is dark only (D-001). :root and .dark carry the same values, so nothing turns light by accident.
notMapped.--radius-4xl: HeyOz has no radius above radius/3xl (24). The file leaves rounded-4xl at Tailwind's default (32px); avoid it.
